adjudication_summary: Source re-review recovered the paper-specific Omicron activity evidence that the parser missed: 12 IC50 rows for EK1, EK1C4, and EKL1C across Calu-3 fusion, Caco2 fusion, pseudovirus infection, and authentic-virus infection. Database conflicts were narrowed to nonblocking modification-normalization cautions for cholesterol-conjugated lipopeptides. The paper is publication-grade with explicit cautions and no open rework target.
